author: Benjamin Paul Kantor
title: The Linguistic Classification of the Reading Traditions of Biblical Hebrew: A Phyla-and-Waves Model
scope: Publisher description establishes a prior-art method for relating Hebrew reading traditions. Chapter-level method and individual claims have not yet been audited here.
sunnyQuestion: Can shared innovations and contact separately constrain genealogical edges among source-native symbol-sound systems?
acceptance: Recover explicit characters and shared innovations, reconstruct the author derivations, then assess transfer conditions before applying them to SUNNY geometry.
